reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs support it: services are engaged on a task-by-task basis under individually negotiated SOWs (p0004) and compensation is time and materials plus actual out-of-pocket expenses (p0013), i.e. fees only for ordered/performed services — the preferred position of no minimum commitment.
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original text.

Rationale correctly notes the absence of take-or-pay, minimum-fee, shortfall or volume-cap language, and appropriately defers the uncapped rate-change point (p0014) to the pricing rule rather than double-flagging under MINCOMMIT.
